items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Gene Rogers the night before last up in Larchmont.

ctx.x: Well, wait a minute, do you know a piano player named Gene, I used to sing with him. Listen, one night I was singing at the bar for kicks -- I'm not lying, and we had a beer glass and when we got finished we had a lot of dollar bills in there.
Would this Gene be Gene Rogers? I worked with Gene Rogers the night before last up in Larchmont.
